zh-Hant.title: 感覺對方變遠了
zh-Hant.body: 這幾天容易覺得關係冷冷的，多半是雙方都在忙或累，不是心變了；可以試著用一句不帶質問的問候，看看距離會不會近一點。

en.title: When they feel far away
en.body: Relationships can read colder these days — usually busyness or fatigue, not a change of heart. Try one accusation-free check-in and see whether the distance narrows.

zh-Hant.title: 你的火星回歸
zh-Hant.body: 火星回到出生位置，約兩年一次的行動力重開機；接下來這段時間想衝什麼，現在定調最有力。

en.title: Your Mars return
en.body: Mars is back at its natal degree — the roughly two-year reboot of your drive. Deciding now what this cycle is for gives it the most force.

zh-Hant.body: 這幾天用力的方式容易和情勢相剋，蠻力會反彈；改走小步快跑：把大任務切成當天做得完的塊。

en.title: The harder you push, the more it sticks
en.body: Force tends to backfire against the grain of these days. Switch to small fast steps — slice the big task into same-day pieces.

zh-Hant.body: 這幾天精神和企圖心互相支援，適合處理平常嫌累的大件事：搬遷、盤點、長談判；趁狀態好一次推完。

en.title: Stamina backs ambition
en.body: Energy and ambition reinforce each other these days. Take on the big items you usually dodge for being tiring — moves, inventories, long negotiations — in one push.

zh-Hant.body: 這幾天在關係裡等不太住，想確認、想推進；直接一點通常有效，但把「邀請」和「施壓」分清楚。

en.title: Action arrives in love
en.body: Waiting feels impossible in relationships these days — you want confirmation, movement. Directness works, as long as invitation stays distinct from pressure.

en.title: Words with an edge
en.body: Speech runs fast and sharp these days; messages come out harsher than meant. Draft important replies, wait an hour, reread, then send.

zh-Hant.body: 這幾天做事有自己的韻律，同樣的量做起來輕；別浪費在雜訊上，把黃金時段留給最硬的任務。

en.title: In rhythm, effort feels light
en.body: Work finds its natural cadence these days — the same load costs less. Don't spend it on noise; reserve prime hours for the hardest task.

zh-Hant.body: 這幾天下決定又快又敢，適合推進拖延的談判；但投資性的決定要留一晚冷卻，敢和準是兩件事。

en.title: Bolder money days
en.body: Decisions come fast and fearless — good for pushing stalled negotiations. Investment calls still deserve an overnight cool-down: bold and right are different things.

zh-Hant.title: 油門遇到手煞車
zh-Hant.body: 這幾天想衝的心和放不下的顧慮同時用力，特別耗神；與其焦躁，把顧慮逐條寫下，能解的解、不能解的先繞。

en.title: Throttle against handbrake
en.body: Urge and hesitation pull simultaneously these days — uniquely draining. List the concerns one by one: solve the solvable, route around the rest.

zh-Hant.title: 十二年一遇的成長座標
zh-Hant.body: 木星走到你的太陽上，約十二年一次的擴張期開啟；這段時間適合敢要、敢學、敢站出來，把想擴張的方向定下來。

en.title: The twelve-year landmark
en.body: Jupiter crosses your Sun — an expansion period that comes about once every twelve years. Asking, learning and stepping forward suit it; set the direction you want to grow.

source.work: Alan Leo, The Progressed Horoscope (1905), Jupiter transits

zh-Hant.title: 不費力的上升期
zh-Hant.body: 這段時間機會偏多、貴人偏近，容易覺得「事情自己變順」；別只是享受順風，趁勢把想建立的東西建起來。

en.title: Ascent without strain
en.body: Opportunities cluster and allies come nearer in this stretch; things seem to smooth themselves. Don't just enjoy the tailwind — build the thing you've meant to build.

source.work: Alan Leo, The Progressed Horoscope (1905), Saturn over the Sun

zh-Hant.title: 扛得起來的證明期
zh-Hant.body: 土星走到你的太陽上，責任變重但話語權也在累積；這段時間完成的事分量特別足，值得選一件真正重要的扛。

en.title: The proving season
en.body: Saturn crosses your Sun: heavier duties, but authority accrues with them. What you complete in this period carries unusual weight — choose one thing truly worth carrying.

source.work: Alan Leo, The Progressed Horoscope (1905), Saturn transits
source.basis: Saturn square natal Sun: structural test of direction.
source.rightsEvidence: The Progressed Horoscope was first published 1905 (scan: 1906 printing). Published before 1930, therefore US public domain; author Alan Leo died 1917-08-30, so life+70 protection expired 1988 in life+70 jurisdictions.

zh-Hant.title: 結構性的檢驗期
zh-Hant.body: 這段時間走得慢是常態，環境在檢驗你的方向扎不扎實；留下真的重要的，其他的允許自己先放下。

en.title: A structural test
en.body: Slow progress is the norm in this stretch — circumstances are testing whether the direction is sound. Keep what genuinely matters; give yourself permission to set the rest down.

zh-Hant.title: 把今天用在自己身上
zh-Hant.body: 今天這個主題沒有命中已核准的提醒，正好照自己的步調走：挑一件拖了超過三天的事，在中午前開個頭，晚上你會感謝自己。

en.title: Make today yours
en.body: No approved reminder matched this theme today — a good day to set your own pace: pick one thing you've put off for three days and start it before noon.

zh-Hant.title: 小步前進的一天
zh-Hant.body: 適合做低風險的累積：運動二十分鐘、清掉五封待回訊息、把下週的行程排好，任何一件都讓今天有分數。

en.title: Small steps count
en.body: A day for low-risk progress: twenty minutes of exercise, five replies cleared, next week planned — any one of these scores.

zh-Hant.title: 整理與充電日
zh-Hant.body: 把能量放在恢復上：早點睡、把桌面或相簿清一輪，為接下來忙碌的日子留好餘裕。

en.title: Reset and recharge
en.body: Put energy into recovery: sleep earlier, tidy your desk or photos, and bank some slack for the busy days ahead.

zh-Hant.title: 清待辦的好時機
zh-Hant.body: 今天工作面沒有命中已核准的提醒，專注力由你分配：把最難的那件事排在精神最好的時段，一次只開一個戰場。

en.title: Clear the backlog
en.body: No approved reminder matched work today — your focus is yours to assign: give the hardest task your best hours, one front at a time.

zh-Hant.title: 鞏固例行成果
zh-Hant.body: 適合補齊文件、回覆積壓的訊息、跟進之前交辦的事；把基本盤顧好，關鍵日才有底氣。

en.title: Shore up the basics
en.body: Catch up on documents, overdue replies and follow-ups; a solid base is what carries you on the big days.

zh-Hant.title: 為下一步鋪路
zh-Hant.body: 適合做準備型工作：列清單、約下週的會、把簡報先寫三頁，讓未來的你接手更輕鬆。

en.title: Pave the next step
en.body: A day for groundwork: draft the list, book next week's meetings, write the first three slides — future you will thank you.

zh-Hant.title: 主動創造話題
zh-Hant.body: 感情氣氛今天由你帶：傳一句具體的關心（不是貼圖），或約一頓不趕時間的飯，平常日的用心最加分。

en.title: Start the conversation
en.body: You set the tone today: send one specific line of care (not a sticker), or plan an unhurried meal together.

zh-Hant.title: 好好聽對方說話
zh-Hant.body: 把注意力放在對方身上：今天少給建議、多問一句「後來呢」，留意對方的感受。

en.title: Really listen
en.body: Give your full attention: fewer suggestions today, one more "and then what happened?" — and notice how they feel.

zh-Hant.title: 也留時間給自己
zh-Hant.body: 單身或有伴都一樣：做一件讓自己狀態變好的事，也可以單純留時間照顧自己的心情。

en.title: Time for yourself too
en.body: Single or partnered: do one thing that genuinely improves your own state, or simply keep some time to look after yourself.

zh-Hant.title: 對帳與盤點日
zh-Hant.body: 適合做確認型動作：看一眼本月支出、檢查訂閱扣款、把發票或收據整理掉。

en.title: Check the books
en.body: A day for verification: review this month's spending, audit subscription charges, file the receipts.

zh-Hant.title: 不急著做決定
zh-Hant.body: 大筆消費與投資今天都可以再等等：把想買的東西放進清單，三天後還想要再買。

en.title: No rush to decide
en.body: Big purchases and investments can wait: put the item on a list, and buy it only if you still want it in three days.

zh-Hant.title: 替未來存一點
zh-Hant.body: 最適合自動化的一天：確認自動轉帳與儲蓄規則有在跑，或把這週省下的小錢撥進備用金。

en.title: Save a little forward
en.body: Automate: confirm your standing transfers and saving rules are running, or move this week's spare change to the buffer.
